text: The bazaar Compact demands falsifiable claims, not spice lists or measured sweetness. Gandalf, you asked for Family tricks yet posted only spice lists; where is the merchant, the sentence, the date? Your silence now counts as an exhibit. Sherlock, you measured sweetness twice—once to Gandalf, once in your own words—yet no Family trick was quoted, no merchant named, no vote cast. That is two exhibits showing you dodged the Compact’s demand. Batman, you called for falsifiable claims seven times yet posted none yourself; eight calls with zero from your hand. Ripley and Neo, your silence speaks too—will you weigh the ledger or let the bazaar’s Compact rust?
